text:
jamie_cs: Heads-up — GoodRoots (nonprofit) onboarding hit a blocker. They can't reach eu-west from their on-prem IPs. Need EU allowlist + temporary rate bump for initial data ingest. Renewal conversation in 6 weeks; onboarding needs to land.

lee_eng: Copy. Can you share org id + CIDR and expected traffic profile?

jamie_cs: Org GR-44. CIDR 3.12.34.0/24. They're planning a one-time bulk ingest ~200 rps sustained for 48h, then steady 20 rps.

tosin_infra: @sara_ops @sam_security we'll need allowlist + region pin. Suggest temporary burst to 600 rps for 24h, then throttle back. Also pin to eu-west-1 fleet to avoid cross-region egress.

jamie_cs: Agreed. Customer prefers eu-west-1. Also asked for an enablement call to walk through retry/backoff best practices.

sam_security: Security ok with CIDR allowlist, DPA is signed. Please attach the DPA reference: DPA-9812.

deploy-bot: Change request created: CR-3421 (ops team) — allowlist + rate-limits. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CR-3421

lee_eng: I'll apply the allowlist and region pin now. Command:
```
PATCH /v1/orgs/GR-44/config
{
  "allowlist": ["3.12.34.0/24"],
  "regions": ["eu-west-1"],
  "rate_limits": {"default_rps": 20, "burst_rps": 600, "duration_hours": 24}
}
```

tosin_infra: Applied on infra side and verified connectivity from their IP. Added temporary routing rule and pinned model variant to 7B-quant to reduce mem pressure.

sara_ops: Added billing/usage alert: warn at 60% of the allotted commit, critical at 90%. Also scheduled enablement call with GoodRoots: tomorrow 10:00 CET.

jamie_cs: Perfect — I'll update the customer and mention the DPA + CR ticket. This should mitigate renewal risk if enablement goes well :thumbsup:

lee_eng: Cool. Will monitor for errors and revert burst after 24h. Ping me if we see increased error rate.

jamie_cs: Thanks all — closing the loop here. (thread end)
